chunks: And none can lead him astray who has been guided by God. Is not God all-mighty, the lord of retribution?
ai.seo_question: Who can mislead those whom God has guided?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to highlight the divine sovereignty in guidance, where God's will is the ultimate determinant, reinforcing the concept of *Jabr* (divine compulsion) in the distribution of guidance and misguidance. It serves as a reassurance to the believers that their path is secured by Allah's power, while the concluding attributes of *Al-Aziz* (The Mighty) and *Dhul Intiqam* (The Possessor of Retribution) underscore the justice of His decree. This duality assures that those guided are protected from external misleading forces, while those left astray face the consequences of their own state.
